description: Mine each thing the other person says for sub-topics ('free information'), then loop back to an earlier topic when the current one stalls (e.g. 'You mentioned imports earlier — what do you import specifically?'). Practiced by consciously branching off keywords.

Move conversations from impersonal facts to feelings: start with situational questions, progress to opinion-based ('What did you think?'), then motivation-based ('What made you get into this?').
Repeat back what someone said in your own words to confirm understanding ('So your favorite thing about London is the old buildings?'), signaling you listened and inviting elaboration.

Set a daily goal of small interactions starting with the lowest stakes (greet a cashier, comment to a stranger) and progressively work up, treating reps as exposure therapy.
Speak at about half the speed you naturally want to, pausing to breathe and for emphasis, to reduce anxious rushing and sound more grounded.
In text conversations, share an interesting detailed anecdote first to model depth before asking the other person an open question, instead of bland 'How was your day?'.
